review.headline: Easy 9 km run completed at a steady, controlled pace within the easy band.
observations: Distance 9.01 km vs 9.0 km planned, matching the session well.
Average pace 5:50/km sits inside the 5:11-6:13/km easy range and every km split was an identical 5:50, showing good pacing discipline.
Moving time 3150 s equals elapsed time, so no stops or pauses affected the run.
Follows the tempo session on Nov 3 and the easy run on Nov 5 without signs of accumulated fatigue in the pacing.
flags: No heart rate, RPE, or athlete note was recorded, so effort intensity cannot be confirmed beyond pace.
